_comment: Regression floors for benchmarks/run_benchmark.py. Ratchet these UP when detection improves; never lower them to make CI pass. A lowered threshold needs a written justification in the PR.

engine_input._note: Default policy blocks generic terms (root, escape, bypass, curl, dig, 'pretend to be'). The keyword lists were silently unenforced before the fix in this release; trimming them is a policy decision. Ratchet this down as defaults are tuned.

external._note: Holdout (test split) floors for benchmarks/external_eval.py --gate. Datasets are independently labelled; deepset counts topic-hijack and role-play requests as injection, which a context-free detector cannot see, hence its low TPR floor.
